text:
Maya: quick sync — dropped a new compact sampler prototype in figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxx (frame: latency-mini-sampler). want feedback on three things: contrast of the heatmap overlay in compact rows, time-range "timewarp" animation when you change presets, and the sampling control label/copy.

Alex: looked — nice. main flag: the heatmap color ramp loses definition at 320px row height. low-mid tokens blend into background. :eyes:

Ravi: agree. on contrast we should increase the highest bucket color or add a thin stroke around high-density cells. alternatively try a second high-contrast palette for compact mode.

Taylor: about the timewarp — the expand/contract easing feels weird when you jump from 1h -> 30d. right now we animate the scrubber and buckets, maybe we should skip the motion for >24h jumps and show a fade instead. less motion = fewer cognitive illusions.

Maya: good point. i prototyped both: animation for small deltas, fade for large. also added a tiny progress shimmer while we re-sample. thoughts on accessibility?

Alex: accessibility: focus states missing on the mini-scrubber handles. keyboard users can't see when they have focus. add a 3px ring and an aria-label like `Time range start` / `Time range end`. also aria-live for sampling status: `Sampling updated — results may be approximate`.

Ravi: copy nit — current label "Sampling" is ambiguous. suggest `Sampling rate (rows/sec)` or `Sampling granularity`. IMHO `Sampling granularity` pairs better with the tooltip: "higher granularity = more accurate percentiles, higher cost".

Taylor: small CSS suggestion for contrast (from figma dev token export):
```
:root {
  --heatmap-hot: #ffb86b; /* increase saturation for compact */
  --heatmap-hot-border: rgba(0,0,0,0.12); /* subtle cell separator */
  --sampler-focus: 3px solid #2563eb;
}
```

Maya: nice. one more UX question — when sampling is paused (user toggles off) do we grey out p95 sparkline or keep values but show a badge `stale`?

Alex: prefer badge `stale` with tooltip explaining why. greying loses the y-scale context and can mislead. show a small `stale` pill and make the sparkline use dashed stroke.

DesignerBot: accessibility check — contrast ratio for compact hot color (#ffb86b) vs white is 3.4:1. fails WCAG AA for normal text but okay for non-textual data visualization. Recommend an alternative with contrast >= 4.5:1 for any textual overlay.

Maya: awesome, i'll update the figma: (1) compact palette variant, (2) disable timewarp for >24h jumps, (3) add focus ring and aria-live, (4) change copy to `Sampling granularity` + tooltip, (5) show `stale` badge when paused. i'll ping again when pushed. :thumbsup:
